How to Book Flights on Cleartrip?
Booking flights on Cleartrip is quick and easy. Follow these simple steps to secure your domestic or international flight tickets:
- Select your departure and arrival locations, travel dates, and the number of passengers.
- Browse through available airlines, fares, and schedules.
- Choose a flight that fits your budget and timing.
- Enter passenger details, apply any available offers, and make a secure payment.
- Get an e-ticket and travel details in your inbox.
Whether you need to book domestic flights for a weekend getaway or book international flights for a vacation abroad, Cleartrip provides a smooth and convenient experience.

How do I create an account on Cleartrip?
For all your travel bookings, sign up on Cleartrip.
Go to the home page, click the link (top right), and enter your email address. We'll then send you an account activation link.
Click it, and you'll be able to access your Cleartrip account.
The account activation link expires three days after you provide us with your email address, so please activate your account within that time frame.
How can I contact Cleartrip customer support?
You can reach Cleartrip Customer Support and Phone Number. Contact us at +91 9595333333. We are here to assist you with your booking and rescheduling queries.
How do I search for flights on Cleartrip?
We make it relatively simple to search and book Cleartrip flights
Hit enter, and you're done! You have a search list of all available flights, sorted by price.
How do I search for hotels on Cleartrip?
Booking a hotel online has never been easier than it is with Cleartrip.
Click the 'hotels' tab on the site.
Enter the city/locality/landmark/hotel name in the search bar.
Enter the check-in and check-out dates.
Choose the number of travellers and press enter.

You may also refine your hotel booking search results by utilising parameters such as price, star rating, traveller rating, facilities, and preferences such as hill-view or couple-friendly hotels. Cleartrip offers hotels for all types of stays. Cleartrip hotels are curated to give you the best value for your money.
How do I book train tickets on Cleartrip?

Cleartrip enables you to buy train tickets and search for them. Simply click 'check availability' on the search results page, and you will find the book button to click for bookings. Booking Cleartrip trains is simple and fast
